root_cause.text: In the crypto/ccp SEV-TSM error path, sev_tsm_init_locked() logs fields from the freed struct t after calling kfree(t), causing a use-after-free due to incorrect cleanup ordering.
root_cause.evidence: The patch in drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev-tsm.c moves `pr_err("Failed to enable SEV-TIO: ret=%d en=%d initdone=%d SEV=%d\n", ret, t->tio_en, t->tio_init_done, ...)` before `kfree(t);`, and the CVE/commit explicitly states that `t->tio_en` and `t->tio_init_done` were dereferenced after the memory had been released.
